title: Mitigating the Contractivity Trap in Diffusion ODEs via Stein Stabilization

claims.text: SteinDiff derives a reference-free, Stein's-identity-based estimator for the MSE-optimal correction coefficient gamma*_k, given by gamma*_k = [(1-1/alpha_k)E[<u_k,x_k>] + (sigma_k^2/alpha_k)E[div(u_k)]] / E[||u_k||^2] (Theorem 4.7).
Theorem 4.8 establishes a step-wise error decay bound for SteinDiff-corrected sampling, showing the terminal error satisfies E^0_Stein <= (1-eta)^N * E_N over N inference steps (Theorem 4.8).
On LSUN-Bedrooms 256x256 at 5 NFE, SteinDiff reduces FID from a baseline of 21.29 to 7.64 (Table 2).
On ImageNet 64x64, SteinDiff yields FID reductions of up to 45.8% relative to baseline solvers, with consistent gains across both DPM-Solver++ and UniPC (Table 2).

Algorithm 1 implements the correction using Hutchinson trace estimation for the divergence term and batch-averaged statistics (s_xu, s_uu, s_div), with a clipped coefficient gamma_hat_k bounded below by a minimum threshold gamma_min (Algorithm 1).

SteinDiff is evaluated against DPM-Solver++ (including third-order), UniPC, and Heun solvers across CIFAR-10, ImageNet 64x64, and LSUN-Bedrooms 256x256, using FID, IS, and FD-DINOv2 metrics at 5-20 NFE (Experimental Results section).
